rule_description: Every workflow's final_expected_value is a floating-point number. Model output must parse to a finite numeric value. Scoring then applies numeric equivalence with tolerance.

scoring_steps.name: parse_output
scoring_steps.requirement: Model output must parse unambiguously to a single finite floating-point number
scoring_steps.failure_mode: PARSE_FAILURE if: not a string, multiple numbers, non-finite (inf/nan), unparseable format

scoring_steps.name: check_gold_type
scoring_steps.requirement: Determine if final_expected_value is integer or float

scoring_steps.name: numeric_equivalence
scoring_steps.requirement: Apply tolerance based on gold type
scoring_steps.float_rule: relative tolerance: math.IsClose(parsed_value, expected, rel_tol=1e-4, abs_tol=1e-6)

integer_gold.description: If gold is an integer (or integer-valued float), parsed output must equal exactly

float_gold.description: If gold is a true float, use math.IsClose with both tolerances. Passes if abs(parsed - gold) <= max(rel_tol * abs(gold), abs_tol)
float_gold.definition: equivalent to Python: math.isclose(parsed, gold, rel_tol=1e-4, abs_tol=1e-6)

failure_taxonomy.parse_failure: model output not parseable as finite number
failure_taxonomy.exact_wrong: parsed number does not match gold (outside tolerance)
failure_taxonomy.contract_failure: workflow protocol violated (e.g., non-VERIFY node emits Fact; unexpected node count)
failure_taxonomy.verification: VERIFY node promoted fact but status != VERIFIED (e.g., UNSUPPORTED)

READ_AND_CHECK.notes: No Fact promotion; VERIFY node should not appear

COMPARE_TWO_VALUES.exact_correct_rule: numeric_equivalence applied to FinalValue; expected = max(A, B)
COMPARE_TWO_VALUES.notes: Corrected from A-B (v1 D4 gold) to max(A, B) (v2 corrected gold)

DIFFERENCE_THEN_VERIFY.fact_status_handling: Status must be VERIFIED; UNSUPPORTED counts as contract_failure
DIFFERENCE_THEN_VERIFY.exact_correct_rule: numeric_equivalence applied to Fact.numeric_value; expected = A - B
DIFFERENCE_THEN_VERIFY.notes: VERIFY is single-target; must read normalized difference

RATIO_OF_DIFFERENCE.fact_status_handling: Status must be VERIFIED; UNSUPPORTED counts as contract_failure
RATIO_OF_DIFFERENCE.exact_correct_rule: numeric_equivalence applied to Fact.numeric_value; expected = (A - B) / C
RATIO_OF_DIFFERENCE.notes: VERIFY is single-target; must read normalized ratio. Note: C is denominator, div-by-zero handled by ARITHMETIC Tlaloque

RECONCILIATION_CHAIN.fact_status_handling: Status must be VERIFIED; UNSUPPORTED counts as contract_failure
RECONCILIATION_CHAIN.exact_correct_rule: numeric_equivalence applied to Fact.numeric_value; expected = fraction - tolerance
RECONCILIATION_CHAIN.notes: VERIFY single-target on norm_margin; cmp_zero verdict lives on Blackboard but not promoted

implementation_notes.parse_step: Use strconv.ParseFloat in Go; handle NaN/Inf explicitly as parse failures
implementation_notes.tolerance_application: Use math.Abs and math.Max as specified; never round or truncate gold
implementation_notes.fact_handling: All VERIFY facts must have Status == VERIFIED; no abstention allowed in primary scoring
implementation_notes.error_recording: Every non-exact_correct output is recorded with failure class; used in section-7 analysis
